latest.title: I Met the Male Lead in Prison
latest.altTitle: 監獄で主人公に出会いました
latest.description:
I met the male lead in the prison. I know he's supposed to be a 19+ tragedy novel male lead, but... Why is he like that?

"Woof! Woof! Woof! Grrr."

It was said that he was cursed to turn into a beast... So, what is it like to awaken from the curse?

"T-t-take responsibility, or d-don't touch me!"

I just felt relieved, thinking there wouldn't be any romantic feelings or involvement between me and the male lead.

"One year later. P-please meet me... on the day I get out of here!"

Meeting him didn't seem too difficult, so I agreed. So I was released first, but...

**

”Come on in. My lovely little sister who's as charming as the flower."

On the day I was released, the man who approached me turned out to be my brother.
I was the villain's sister.

"You went through a lot on my behalf, didn't you? I've been waiting for you."

…Fuck. On top of it all, I’m the precious little sister of the villain who is the male lead’s nemesis?

**

Three years later, when we met again, the male lead smiled with a completely different face.

"Hello, Iyana. I'm going to kidnap you from now on."
latest.author: Moon Sihyun (문시현)

latest.title: The Ghostly Doctor
latest.altTitle: Mesmerizing Ghost Doctor
latest.description:
She, the leader of the hidden sect, specializes in poison and assassination. A genius, and a weirdo, in the eyes of others. After dying from an accident, she was reborn in the body of a disfigured lady. Having her identity changed and unable to return to her family, she abandoned them, but, if she doesn't take revenge on those who caused her harm, will she be worthy of the title "The Ghostly Doctor"? As clouds gather, heroes fight to be the strongest! How will she conquer the world in a red robe, and fight among the strong heroes?!  
  
*The 2 missing chapters are announcements by the author.  


---
latest.author: Feng Jiong

latest.title: Hidden Powerhouse Peace-loving Maid
latest.altTitle: Hidden Powerhouse Peace-loving Maid
latest.description:
Andert the Hero. A great swordsman who ended the great war by sacrificing himself. One of the greatest heroes of all time.

…But in truth, I was a woman disguised as a man, living under the identity of my dead younger brother. That was me.

And then—

“Huh?”

I came back to life… four years after dying?

With nothing but this body left, there was only one way to survive.

A maid.

“Which kind of household would you like to work in?” “A place so harsh and awful that even if one of two workers dies, no one would notice.” “And what kind of employer are you looking for?” “A vicious employer who squeezes their workers dry.”

That way, I’ll be the only one willing to work there—and they won’t be able to fire me.

“……”

The interviewer looked at me like I was completely insane.

Still, it doesn’t matter.

Here, I’ll start over.

Not as the hero Andert. Not as my dead younger brother.

But as a maid— Daisy.

His summoner, the goddess Clemontine, gives him an unusual mission – to make seven girls, destined to become the mothers of the next generation of heroes, fall in love again. These girls have lost their ability to love due to a curse cast by the Demon King. In other words, Haruchika must make them fall for him!

To return to his world and hear the answer to his confession, Haruchika accepts this mission and sets out to save another world through love. Having mastered the art of romance through psychology and become a Love Master, his journey to fulfill his first love begins now.

latest.altTitle: 老後に備えて異世界で8万枚の金貨を貯めます
latest.description:
After growing up an orphan, Mitsuha has a healthy respect for money and a desire to live well—at least, until she dies after being pushed off a cliff. Waking up in a strange fantasy world, Mitsuha narrowly survives an encounter with a pack of wolves, then realizes she has the power to move between this world and the real one. A lesser person might embark on heroic adventures—Mitsuha instead immediately recognizes the lucrative possibilities of her new situation, and heads out to buy an arsenal of modern weapons. Her goal: to acquire 80,000 gold, and the life of leisure she's always dreamed of!

Ferdinand, the High Priest of the temple of Ehrenfest, has three trusted people: the knight Eckhart, the civil servant Justus, and his attendant Lasfam. They meet whenever the occasion arises and share all sorts of information. What follows is the true nature of these people, unfolding behind the scenes of the main story.

Reading this will make you love the world of "Bookworms" even more! This is the start of a series of exquisite bibliophile fantasy stories told from the perspectives of three people who pledge their loyalty to Ferdinand

latest.altTitle: 陰の実力者になりたくて！
latest.description:
Just like how everyone adored heroes in their childhood, a certain young man adored those powers hidden in shadows. Ninjas, rogues, shadowy mentor types, that sort of deal.  
After hiding his strength and living the mediocre life of a NPC by day while undergoing frenzied training by night, he finally reincarnates into a different world and gains ultimate power.  
The young man who is only pretending to be a power in the shadows… his subordinates who took him more seriously than he expected… and a giant organization in the shadows that gets accidentally trampled…  
This is the story of a young boy who had adored powers in shadows possibly eventually reigning over the world of shadows in another world.

popular.altTitle: 葬送のフリーレン
popular.description: The adventure is over but life goes on for an elf mage just beginning to learn what living is all about. Elf mage Frieren and her courageous fellow adventurers have defeated the Demon King and brought peace to the land. With the great struggle over, they all go their separate ways to live a quiet life. But as an elf, Frieren, nearly immortal, will long outlive the rest of her former party. How will she come to terms with the mortality of her friends? How can she find fulfillment in her own life, and can she learn to understand what life means to the humans around her? Frieren begins a new journey to find the answer.

popular.altTitle: 乙女ゲー世界はモブに厳しい世界です
popular.description: Leon, a former Japanese worker, was reincarnated into an "otome game" world, and despaired at how it was a world where females hold dominance over males. It was as if men were just livestock that served as stepping stones for females in this world. The only exceptions were the game's romantic targets, a group of handsome men led by the crown prince. In these bizarre circumstances, Leon held one weapon: his knowledge from his previous world, where his brazen sister had forced him to complete this game.
popular.author: Mishima Yomu

popular.title: One Punch-Man
popular.altTitle: ワンパンマン
popular.description:
After rigorously training for three years, the ordinary Saitama has gained immense strength which allows him to take out anyone and anything with just one punch. He decides to put his new skill to good use by becoming a hero. However, he quickly becomes bored with easily defeating monsters, and wants someone to give him a challenge to bring back the spark of being a hero.  
  
Upon bearing witness to Saitama's amazing power, Genos, a cyborg, is determined to become Saitama's apprentice. During this time, Saitama realizes he is neither getting the recognition that he deserves nor known by the people due to him not being a part of the Hero Association. Wanting to boost his reputation, Saitama decides to have Genos register with him, in exchange for taking him in as a pupil. Together, the two begin working their way up toward becoming true heroes, hoping to find strong enemies and earn respect in the process.  
  



---

**Notes:**  
- Because some groups use the web version of the manga while others use the magazine version, the numbering won't match between different languages.  
- **Because a takedown notice was sent to MangaDex from the owners of this series, fan translations of One Punch Man are currently unavailable to be uploaded. The series can be read in its entirety at [the official Shonen Jump website,](https://www.viz.com/shonenjump/chapters/one-punch-man) with the first and latest three chapters available at any time and the rest accessible with a Shonen Jump membership (which costs about $2 a month and can be accessed via a VPN if you are outside the US).**
popular.author: ONE

popular.title: Mushoku Tensei: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu
popular.altTitle: 無職転生　～異世界行ったら本気だす～
popular.description: A 34-year-old NEET gets killed in a traffic accident and finds himself in a world of magic. Rather than waking up as a full-grown mage, he gets reincarnated as a newborn baby, retaining the memories of his past life. Before he can even properly move his body, he resolves to never make the same mistakes he made in his first life ever again and instead live a life with no regrets with the new one that was given to him. Because he has the knowledge of a middle-aged man, by the age of two, he has already become a prodigy and possesses power unthinkable for anyone his age and even older. Thus begins the chronicles of Rudeus Greyrat, son of swordsman Paul and healer Zenith, as he enters a new world to become the strongest mage known to man, with powers rivaling even the gods themselves.
popular.author: Rifujin na Magonote

Komi-san is a beautiful and admirable girl that no one can take their eyes off of. Almost the whole school sees her as the cold beauty that's out of their league, but Tadano Hitohito knows the truth: she's just really bad at communicating with others.

Komi-san, who wishes to fix this bad habit of hers, tries to improve it with the help of Tadano-kun by achieving her goal of having 100 friends.

Despite this, he takes Fenrys of the demons as his wife, and fully enjoys his newly-married life with an easygoing smile. He changes his name to Flio and tries to lead his life quietly, but things are a bit chaotic with the likes of a pet saber, four freeloading female knights, a Majin, and even an ex-Demon Lord. popular.description:
Naoto Hachiouji —our spineless— MC (Known also as "Senpai") is a second-year high school student and a loner who spends his afternoons at the Arts Club room. He attracts the attention of one of his schoolmates, a sadistic freshman girl named Nagatoro. However, in between the bullying and teasing, something else begins to blossom.

A lovey-dovey(…?) story between a shy nerd and an S-Dere (Sadistic Tsundere) begins.

---

**Links:**

- Alternative Official English - [K Manga](https://kmanga.kodansha.com/title/10042/episode/313808) (U.S. Only)
popular.author: 774 (Nanashi)

popular.title: Tsuki ga Michibiku Isekai Douchuu
popular.altTitle: 月が導く異世界道中
popular.description:
High school student Misumi Makoto is called into a fantasy world by the god Tsukuyomi, in order to be a hero. However, powerful others in this world aren't as thrilled to have him there, and they kick him to the edge of the world just as Tsukuyomi declares that he must leave Makoto to find his own way. Now it's up to Makoto to find his own way!
___
[Official English Light Novel](https://hanashi.media/series/tsukimichi/)
popular.author: Azumi Kei

popular.title: Kumo desu ga, Nani ka?
popular.altTitle: 蜘蛛ですが、なにか？
popular.description:
When a mysterious explosion killed an entire class full of high school students, the souls of everyone in class were transported into a fantasy world and reincarnated. While some students were reincarnated as princes or prodigies, others were not as blessed.  
Our heroine, who was the lowest in the class, discovered that she was reincarnated as a spider! Now at the bottom of the food chain, she needs to adapt to the current situation with willpower in order to live. Stuck in a dangerous labyrinth filled with monsters, it's eat or be eaten!  
This is the story of a spider doing whatever she can in order to survive!
popular.author: Baba Okina

popular.title: Ki ni Natteru Hito ga Otoko ja Nakatta
popular.altTitle: 気になってる人が男じゃなかった
popular.description:
Series Pendek Twitter yang menggambarkan cerita tentang Gyaru dan Teman Sekelasnya.
Gyaru yang suka musik rock dan sering mendatangi toko kaset jatuh cinta ke pekerja paruh waktu yang bekerja disitu, tapi sedikit dia tahu ternyata pekerjanya itu perempuan dan teman sekelasnya.
popular.author: Arai Sumiko

popular.title: Mairimashita! Iruma-kun
popular.altTitle: 魔入りました！入間くん
popular.description: Hopeless pushover Iruma Suzuki has found himself in a devil of a predicament... His trashy parents have sold off his soul, and he now has to live and attend school in the Netherworld. But with his unique survival skills and doting demon grandfather’s support, Iruma will surely make it through this hellish experience. He'll just need to subjugate rival classmates, summon familiars, and more, all while never revealing that he's human... Easy as *aleph, bet, gimel*, right?
popular.author: Nishi Osamu

popular.title: Anta to Osananajimi tte dake demo Iya nanoni! ~Zekkou kara Hajimaru S-kyuu Bishoujo to no Gakuen Nariagari Seikatsu~
popular.altTitle: アンタと幼なじみってだけでもイヤなのに！～絶交から始まるS級美少女との学園成り上がり生活～
popular.description:
Kazuma Suzuki hanyalah siswa SMA biasa—sampai sahabat masa kecilnya, Rua Takayashiki, seorang gadis cantik berlidah tajam yang juga merupakan cucu dari kepala sekolah dan idola nasional, memutuskan semua hubungan dengannya menggunakan dialog yang diambil dari sebuah drama.

Dipaksa tunduk selama bertahun-tahun sebagai apa yang disebut sahabat masa kecilnya, Kazuma memutuskan bahwa inilah saatnya untuk pemberontakan pertamanya. Ia sudah selesai menjadi anjing piaraan. Kali ini, ia mengambil kembali kebebasannya—dan mengincar kehidupan sekolah yang normal.

Melarikan diri dari wanita cantik yang kuat seperti dia lebih mudah diucapkan daripada dilakukan...
popular.author: Yuuji Yuuji

popular.title: Mieruko-chan
popular.altTitle: 見える子ちゃん
popular.description:
All of a sudden, Miko is able to see grotesque monsters all around her; but no one else can. Rather than trying to run away or face them, she instead musters all of her courage and… ignores them. Join in on her day-to-day life as she keeps up her best poker face despite the supernatural goings-on.
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [niconico Manga](http://manga.nicovideo.jp/comic/37662)
popular.author: Izumi Tomoki

popular.title: Akuyaku Reijou Level 99 ~Watashi wa Ura Boss desuga Maou de wa Arimasen~
popular.altTitle: 悪役令嬢レベル９９～私は裏ボスですが魔王ではありません～
popular.description:
Aku bereinkarnasi menjadi antagonis "Dolkness Eumelia" dari gim otome RPG. Di cerita utamanya, Eumelia hanyalah seorang karakter sampingan, tapi setelah ending, ia memasuki cerita lagi dengan menjadi bos rahasia, menjadi karakter yang mempunyai status lebih tinggi daripada pahlawan!!  
  
Memantik jiwa gamer-ku, lalu mengambil kesempatan karena ditinggal oleh keluargaku di wilayah mereka, aku berlatih! Berlatih! Lalu pada akhir pelatihanku saat aku baru memasuki akademi, ternyata levelku mencapai 99.  
  
Walaupun aku sudah membuat rencana untuk hidup tanpa mencolok dan damai, beberapa saat setelah masuk sekolah, aku disangka "Raja Iblis" oleh si Heroine dan Para Target Cintanya …?  
  
Diangkat dari Web Novel yang populer yang mencari kehidupan damai, sebuah cerita fantasi tentang antagonis terkuat!
popular.author: Tanabata Satori

popular.title: Jujutsu Kaisen
popular.altTitle: 呪術廻戦
popular.description:
For some strange reason, Itadori Yuuji, despite his insane athleticism, would rather just hang out with the Occult Club. However, he soon finds out that the occult is as real as it gets when his fellow club members are attacked!

Meanwhile, the mysterious Fushiguro Megumi is tracking down a special-grade cursed object, and his search leads him to Itadori…
___
**Official English Volumes:** [VIZ](https://www.viz.com/shonenjump/chapters/jujutsu-kaisen)
popular.author: Akutami Gege

popular.title: Kaoru Hana wa Rin to Saku
popular.altTitle: 薫る花は凛と咲く
popular.description:
In a certain place, there are two neighboring high schools. Chidori High School, a bottom-feeder boys' school where idiots gather, and Kikyo Girls' School, a well-established girls' school. Rintaro Tsumugi, a strong and quiet second year student at Chidori High School, meets Kaoruko Waguri, a girl who comes as a customer while helping out at his family's cake shop. Rintaro feels comfortable spending time with Kaoruko, but she is a student at Kikyo Girls, a neighboring school that thoroughly dislikes Chidori High.
___
**Links:**
- [Official Twitter (JP)](https://twitter.com/kaoruhana_mp)
- Official English - [K MANGA](https://kmanga.kodansha.com/title/10023/episode/320130) (Simulpub)
popular.author: Mikami Saka

popular.title: Kusuriya no Hitorigoto
popular.altTitle: 薬屋のひとりごと
popular.description: Diculik dan dijual ke harem, Maomao berusaha bertahan dengan kemampuannya beradaptasi. Wawasan yang luas tentang obat-obatan membuat karirnya melompat tinggi, langsung menjadi pelayan pribadi selir kesayangan kaisar!
popular.author: Hyuuga Natsu

popular.title: One Piece
popular.altTitle: ワンピース
popular.description:
From Viz:
As a child, Monkey D. Luffy was inspired to become a pirate by listening to the tales of "Red-Haired" Shanks. But his life changed when Luffy accidentally ate the Gum-Gum Devil Fruit and gained the power to stretch like rubber at the cost of never being able to swim again. Years later, still vowing to become the king of the pirates, Luffy sets out on his adventure one guy alone in a rowboat, in search of the legendary "One Piece," said to be the greatest treasure in the world.

The best-selling manga in history and tied with Superman for the best-selling comics in history.

popular.title: Dungeon ni Hisomu Yandere na Kanojo ni Ore wa Nandomo Korosareru
popular.altTitle: ダンジョンに潜むヤンデレな彼女に俺は何度も殺される
popular.description:
Kiska, a boy who was mistreated by the villagers, was able to get by thanks to his childhood friend, Namia, who was the only one who stood by him. One day, Namia is found murdered in the village. Kiska is framed for the murder by the other villagers, and banished to an inescapable S-class dungeon…?
___
**Character Designer:** [Tomo](https://mangadex.org/author/645c60f7-a644-45b2-8c9e-4932a87fe187)
popular.author: Kitagawa Nikita

rating.title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: Part 7 - Steel Ball Run Color-ban
rating.altTitle: ジョジョの奇妙な冒険 第7部 カラー版
rating.description: In the American Old West, the world's greatest race is about to begin. Thousands line up in San Diego to travel over six thousand kilometers for a chance to win the grand prize of fifty million dollars. With the era of the horse reaching its end, contestants are allowed to use any kind of vehicle they wish. Competitors will have to endure grueling conditions, traveling up to a hundred kilometers a day through uncharted wastelands. The Steel Ball Run is truly a one-of-a-kind event.  The youthful Johnny Joestar, a crippled former horse racer, has come to San Diego to watch the start of the race. There he encounters Gyro Zeppeli, a racer with two steel balls at his waist instead of a gun. Johnny witnesses Gyro using one of his steel balls to unleash a fantastical power, compelling a man to fire his gun at himself during a duel. In the midst of the action, Johnny happens to touch the steel ball and feels a power surging through his legs, allowing him to stand up for the first time in two years. Vowing to find the secret of the steel balls, Johnny decides to compete in the race, and so begins his bizarre adventure across America on the Steel Ball Run.
rating.author: Araki Hirohiko

rating.title: Uma Musume - Cinderella Gray
rating.altTitle: ウマ娘　シンデレラグレイ
rating.description: Uma Musume: Cinderella Gray is a spin-off title of the Uma Musume project by Cygames. It follows Oguri Cap through her time at Kasamatsu Training Center Academy and on her journey of becoming a legendary horse girl.
rating.author: Sugiura Masafumi

rating.title: Veil
rating.description:
"He", a police officer on his shift, happened to meet "her" on the streets, by chance.

Through its bold yet delicate brushwork and elegant prose, this stylish, full-colour comic
illustrates the subtle air of intimacy between these two individuals.

---
A chance encounter. A handsome policeman. A beautiful woman. A tentative love affair smolders on the snowy cobblestone streets, 
out of sight from those that might keep them apart. 

*Veil* is a beautifully illustrated full-color romance manga, told in stylish short vignettes, beautiful illustrations, and secret moments.
rating.author: Fukuda Ikumi

rating.title: On the Way to Meet Mom
rating.altTitle: On the Way to Meet Mom
rating.description: One day, after being discovered in an abandoned house by a rescue team, Mori suddenly finds himself in a children's protection center. Here, he begins to learn a new way of life – one that includes grand care packages sent by a mysterious patron. But when his closest friend is reunited with her mother and leaves the center, Mori learns for the first time the existence of a mother for every child, and decides to embark on a journey to find his own. But what sort of obstacles wait along the way?
rating.author: Gomyang

rating.title: Chiikawa: Nanka Chiisakute Kawaii Yatsu (Webcomic Pages)
rating.altTitle: なんか小さくてかわいいやつ
rating.description: Follow the adventures of Chiikawa the innocent cute creature, Hachiware the kind cat, and Usagi the chaotic rabbit as they work their hardest to survive in a world filled with dangerous monsters, mysterious armored taskmasters, and fantastical phenomena at every turn!
rating.author: Nagano

rating.title: The Greatest Estate Developer
rating.altTitle: 史上最高の領地設計士
rating.description:
When civil engineering student Suho Kim falls asleep reading a fantasy novel, he wakes up as a character in the book.

 Suho is now in the body of Lloyd Frontera, a lazy noble who loves to drink, and whose family is in a mountain of debt. Using his engineering knowledge, Suho designs inventions to avert the terrible future that lies in wait for him. 

With the help of a giant hamster, a knight, and the world’s magic, can Suho dig his new family out of debt and build a better future?
rating.author: Lee Hyunmin (이현민)

rating.title: Kimi to Tsuzuru Utakata
rating.description:
Shizuku Hoshikawa, seorang gadis SMA yang hidupnya dihindari kontak dengan orang lain, menulis novel yang secara tidak sengaja dibaca oleh teman sekelasnya Kaori Asaka.
Dia menyukainya tetapi mengetahui bahwa Hoshikawa tidak berencana menulis lagi karena kurangnya ide, sehingga dia akhirnya berkata:
"Ayo kita mulai berkencan, kau dan aku... Kau bisa menulis cerita tentang cinta kita sendiri."
rating.author: Yuama

rating.title: My Bias Gets on the Last Train
rating.altTitle: My Bias Gets on the Last Train
rating.description: Lee Yeowoon adalah seorang mahasiswa yang bekerja sampai larut malam hingga membuatnya selalu naik kereta terakhir. Saat menunggu kereta terakhir itu, dia selalu berpapasan dengan Shin Haein, wanita misterius yang membawa gitar. Mereka menjadi lebih dekat setelah percakapan pertama. Namun, tanpa Yeowoon sadari, wanita misterius itu ternyata musisi indie “Long Afternoon” yang merupakan idolanya. Apakah nantinya Yeowoon mengetahui bahwa Haein adalah musisi yang dia idolakan? Akankah Haein mengungkap identitasnya?
rating.author: JIXKSEE (직씨)

rating.title: Kaoru Hana wa Rin to Saku
rating.description:
In a certain place, there are two neighboring high schools. Chidori High School, a bottom-feeder boys' school where idiots gather, and Kikyo Girls' School, a well-established girls' school. rating.author: Mikami Saka

rating.title: Pokemon: Ouja no Saiten
rating.description:
The Indigo League: the ultimate challenge for Pokémon trainers. Structured like a massive tournament, anyone eager to show off their Pokémon can participate, from rookies to gym leaders to even the Elite Four themselves.  
  
This is the story of Red, Blue, and Green, three friends who decide to partake in the tournament.
rating.author: Seijun Tombo

rating.title: Yotsuba to!
rating.description:
Yotsuba is a strange little girl with a big personality! Even in the most trivial, unremarkable encounters, Yotsuba's curiosity and enthusiasm quickly turns the everyday into the extraordinary!

---
- **Won the Excellence Award for Manga at the Japan Media Arts Festival in 2006**


---
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Elex Media (2007)
rating.author: Azuma Kiyohiko

rating.title: Dungeon Meshi
rating.description:
Seorang penjelajah muda, Laios, bersama kawan-kawannya mendapat serangan hebat dari seekor naga jauh di lantai terdalam Dungeon. Mereka kehilangan seluruh uang dan perbekalan, bahkan seorang anggota tim! Walau ingin bergegas kembali dan menyelamatkan rekannya, mereka dihalangi satu masalah besar, “Tanpa makanan dan uang, mereka pasti akan kelaparan di tengah penjelajahan!” Namun, Laios mendapat ide cemerlang, “Kita makan monster saja!”. Slime, kalajengking, basilisk, mandrake, dan kelelawar raksasa… Tidak ada satu monster pun yang luput dari perut-perut keroncongan di Dungeon!! (Gramedia.com) 

[Terjemah Indonesia](https://www.gramedia.com/search?q=delicious%20in%20dungeon)
rating.author: Kui Ryouko

rating.altTitle: ジョジョの奇妙な冒険 Part7『スティール・ボール・ラン』

Thousands line up in San Diego to travel over six thousand kilometers for a chance to win the grand prize of fifty million dollars. With the era of the horse reaching its end, contestants are allowed to use any kind of vehicle they wish. rating.title: Fabulous Beasts
rating.description:
"In this realm mythological creatures roam, descendant of the nine heavens they call home." 

Sibuxiang, a mythical deer-man couch potato, is kicked out of heaven and assigned to support the mythological creatures wandering the human world. He meets and goes on adventures with his friends: the energetic, food loving Pixiu named Pipi, the fanatic moon bunny Tuye, the banished-from-heaven mouse brothers Jinjiao and Yinjiao, and many others. What kind of adventures will they take on?
rating.author: 靴下猫腰子

rating.title: Amayo no Tsuki
rating.description: One rainy night, Saki is rushing to a piano lesson when she crashes into a beautiful, long-haired girl, dropping her sheet music in the process. Saki stutters an apology, but the girl simply hands back her sheet music and leaves without a word. Saki begins her first day of high school the following morning, only to find the stranger from the night before sitting at the desk next to hers. She learns that the girl's name is Kanon and that she is not quite completely deaf, but very hard of hearing. Though Kanon needs to be close to people to read their lips, she tends to push people away with her icy demeanor. Through one kind gesture, Saki slowly begins breaking down the walls around Kanon, even as she feels something new blossoming within her.
rating.author: Kuzushiro

rating.title: Bungou Stray Dogs
rating.altTitle: 文豪ストレイドッグス
rating.description: Nakajima Atsushi was kicked out of his orphanage, and now he has no place to go and no food. While he is standing by a river, on the brink of starvation, he rescues a man whimsically attempting suicide. That man is Dazai Osamu, and he and his partner Kunikida are members of a very special detective agency. They have supernatural powers, and deal with cases that are too dangerous for the police or the military. They're tracking down a tiger that has appeared in the area recently, around the time Atsushi came to the area. The tiger seems to have a connection to Atsushi, and by the time the case is solved, it is clear that Atsushi's future will involve much more of Dazai and the rest of the detectives!
rating.author: Asagiri Kafka

rating.title: Mairimashita! Iruma-kun - If Episode of Mafia
rating.altTitle: 魔入りました！入間くん　ｉｆ　Ｅｐｉｓｏｄｅ　ｏｆ　魔フィア
rating.description: The beloved characters of Mairimashita! Iruma-kun star in this Mafia-based spinoff! Young Iruma saves an injured mob boss from death... and then becomes his grandson!?
rating.author: Hiroja

rating.title: Sasaki to Miyano
rating.description: It all started like a typical old-school boys’ love plotline—bad-boy senior meets adorably awkward underclassman, one of them falls in love, and so on and so forth. But although Miyano is a self-proclaimed boys’ love expert, he hasn’t quite realized…he’s in one himself. Which means it’s up to Sasaki to make sure their story has a happily ever after…!
rating.author: Harusono Shou

rating.title: Kokou no Hito
rating.description: On his first day of transferring to a new high school, a loner named Mori Buntarou, is cajoled by a classmate into climbing the school building. Despite knowing that one misstep could send him spiraling to his death, he moves forward, and upon finally reaching the top, Mori experiences a sense of fulfillment. That feeling, which seems to be telling him, "You're alive!" gives birth to an adrenaline for rock-climbing.
rating.author: Sakamoto Shinichi

rating.title: Otonari no Tenshi-sama ni Itsunomanika Dame Ningen ni Sareteita Ken: after the rain
rating.altTitle: お隣の天使様にいつの間にか駄目人間にされていた件　after the rain
rating.description: A spin-off of the series *[The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten](https://mangadex.org/title/2fec6641-beb1-4ae9-a32f-204dd06688ac/the-angel-next-door-spoils-me-rotten)* which comicalizes the stories from Volume 5.5 of the Light Novel and its special edition booklet, which contains additional short stories.
rating.author: Saeki-san

rating.title: Kono Oto Tomare!
rating.description: Since the graduation of the senior members of the club, Takezou ends up being the sole member of the "Koto" (traditional Japanese string instrument) club. Now that the new school year has begun, Takezou will have to seek out new members for the club, or the club will be terminated. Out of nowhere, a new member barges into the near-abandoned club room, demanding to join the club. How will Takezou be able to keep his club alive and deal with this rascal of a new member?
rating.author: Sakura Amyuu

rating.title: Sousou no Frieren
rating.description: The adventure is over but life goes on for an elf mage just beginning to learn what living is all about. Elf mage Frieren and her courageous fellow adventurers have defeated the Demon King and brought peace to the land. With the great struggle over, they all go their separate ways to live a quiet life. But as an elf, Frieren, nearly immortal, will long outlive the rest of her former party. How will she come to terms with the mortality of her friends? How can she find fulfillment in her own life, and can she learn to understand what life means to the humans around her? Frieren begins a new journey to find the answer.
rating.author: Yamada Kanehito

rating.title: I Have No Home
rating.description:
Haejoon Goh, who ran from home, and Eunyung Baek, the problem child who lives in a tent.   
These two, who met under terrible circumstances, are forced to live together in an abandoned dormitory.   
This is a story of difficult growth between two people who hate both the dorm and each other.
rating.author: Wanan
